verdict.rationale: Aircall's marketing says calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform, and that a shared inbox keeps every conversation visible so the team can collaborate and step in. Together these indicate SMS conversations reach a team-visible shared inbox. However, no evidence explicitly ties inbound texts to the business number to that inbox or shows reply attribution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that inbound SMS to the business number routes into the shared inbox, evidence that the inbox shows which agent replied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform
A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
